faq.q: Is Langley City the same as the Township of Langley?
faq.a: No — the City of Langley is a separate municipality with its own Official Community Plan (adopted November 22, 2021, built on the Nexus of Community vision) and its own Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300; the Township has its own bylaws, and the two must not be mixed (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Langley City Land Use Plans?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Langley City Land Use Plans is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
